start: ^Nurse Raval: Can't stop. Manual obs on all six, every fifteen minutes, no monitors.
^Nurse Raval: If it's the computers you're here for, get on with it.
^Fifteen minutes is a long gap on an ECMO bed.

c-1: ^Nurse Raval: Their charts back on a screen, so I can see six people at once.
^Nurse Raval: That's the whole list. Go and do it.
c-2: ^Narrator: She stops, just for a second.
^Nurse Raval: It is. That's why Sister's not left bay two since three o'clock.
^Nurse Raval: Now shift. You're stood where I need to be.

bed4_assist: ^Nurse Raval: He's fighting the vent. The bag's on the frame and I need both hands.
^Give me the bag. I'll breathe for him.
^I can't stay. Shout if it gets worse.

c-0: ^Narrator: You seal the bag over Mr Pryce's mouth and nose and squeeze, in time with his chest. Raval clears the circuit. The alarm slows to a steady beep.
^Nurse Raval: That's it. Keep that rhythm.
c-1: ^Nurse Raval: It's already worse. Go on, then.
